Pre-dates the frontier-AI debate and hasn't fully repositioned to it. Most influential as a multistakeholder venue for non-technical issues that frontier-only forums (FMF, AISI Network) skip.
changes.to: Member-driven org with academics, NGOs, media, and tech firms; produces guidance on synthetic media disclosure, AI in journalism, AI workforce impacts. Pre-dates the frontier-AI debate; its frontier-relevant work is the 2023 Guidance for Safe Foundation Model Deployment and a 2026 report tracking 13 organisations' public disclosure of foundation-model impacts. Most influential as a multistakeholder venue for non-technical issues that frontier-only forums (FMF, AISI Network) skip.

versions.why: The entry says PAI 'hasn't fully repositioned' to frontier AI without mentioning its frontier-model work. That work is the Guidance for Safe Foundation Model Deployment (2023), a framework for model providers, and a 2026 report tracking 13 organisations against it.
versions.rationale: The guidance is described on PAI's home page (paihome#p1). The 2026 report covers 13 organisations and builds on the 2023 guidance (paitr#p1).
versions.uncertainty: Whether this amounts to 'repositioning' is a judgment; the edit replaces the judgment with the facts. 'AI in journalism' guidance was not checked and is carried over.
